messages.subject: File Upload Issue for IE 9
parts:
Dear all,
 
I cannot upload a csv file to our own-hosted Shiny Server (based on Ubuntu 12.04) using IE 9. With Firefox the upload works wihout problems.
 
I have read a post from March that this issue is known. Does anybody know a workaround or is the issue already solved.
 
Thank you very much for your help.
 
Best regards,
